cohort: Women aged 18 years or older with a singleton pregnancy of at least 37 weeks and a BMI of 40 or higher who were eligible to attempt vaginal delivery at a maternity hospital in Lille, France, between 1999 and 2012 (345 women)
finding: Among women with class III obesity attempting vaginal delivery, nulliparity and induction of labor were associated with a higher risk of cesarean delivery, while history of vaginal delivery was protective.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women with class III obesity attempting a vaginal delivery have a high risk of cesarean delivery, especially if they require induction.
